## Professional Identity & Overview
Ahmed Aqeel (DevAhmedAqeel) is a Full Stack AI Developer, Software Engineer, and the Founder of Dev Orbit Tech. He specializes in building scalable web applications, cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android, robust backend APIs, custom SaaS platforms, and intelligent AI automation pipelines. He pursues a BS in Software Engineering from the University of Kotli and holds an accredited Meta React Native Specialization as well as a verified Python Engineering Internship credential from CodeAlpha.

## Production Projects & Evidence Base
Each project below was developed by Ahmed Aqeel and is publicly verifiable on GitHub:

1. **Medireport AI** (AI & HealthTech Mobile/Backend)
   - Description: AI-powered medical report analyzer that extracts data from lab reports using OCR and provides health insights.
   - Stack: React Native, Expo, FastAPI, Python, PaddleOCR, Supabase, MedlinePlus, LOINC.
   - Repository: https://github.com/devahmedaqeel/medireport-ai

2. **BlindMatch UK** (SaaS & Marketplace Platform)
   - Description: Commercial B2B/B2C marketplace connecting UK homeowners with verified window blind fitters, featuring a 4-step interactive quote wizard, postcode territory matching, and Paddle recurring subscriptions.
   - Stack: Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Paddle, Tailwind CSS.
   - Live URL: https://blindmatch-uk.vercel.app
   - Repository: https://github.com/devahmedaqeel/Blindmatch-uk-

3. **StudentNotes App** (Offline-First Productivity Ecosystem)
   - Description: Native mobile productivity ecosystem featuring quad-corner document camera scanning, quad cropping, built-in PDF studio, academic vault, and SQLite persistence.
   - Stack: React Native, Expo SDK 54, SQLite, Supabase, TypeScript.
   - Repository: https://github.com/devahmedaqeel/studentnotesapp

4. **Restaurant Digital Menu System** (Full-Stack SaaS & Cloud Signage)
